title: Generating Clinical Vignettes that Preserve Cognitive Formulations
abstract: arXiv:2608.29995v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models can generate fluent clinical case vignettes, but fluency alone does not ensure fidelity to a specifiable clinical structure. We introduce FORMA, a theory-grounded framework that compiles a cognitive model of a disorder into a directed weighted graph, samples a person-specific configuration of that graph, and validates whether the generated vignette preserves the specified components and causal links. We instantiate FORMA on Posttraumatic Stress Disorder using the Ehlers and Clark cognitive model, generating 16,500 vignettes across 500 personas, 11 generation models, and three ablation conditions. Evaluation combines an external edge-recovery probe, two clinical experts, a scaled LLM judge, and a clinician user study with 100 licensed practitioners. The cognitive graph is recoverable from full-condition vignettes (MCC = +0.41, AUC = 0.70) but not from zero-shot generation (MCC = +0.01, AUC = 0.50). Experts rate ful

translated_title: 生成保留认知构念的临床病例情境
translated_abstract: 大语言模型能够生成流畅的临床病例情境，但仅凭流畅性并不能确保忠实于可明确规定的临床结构。我们提出了FORMA，一个基于理论的框架，它将某种障碍的认知模型编译为有向加权图，从该图中采样个体特定的配置，并验证生成的病例情境是否保留了指定的成分和因果联系。我们使用Ehlers和Clark认知模型在创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）上实例化了FORMA，在500个人物设定、11个生成模型和三种消融条件下生成了16,500个病例情境。评估结合了外部的边恢复探针、两位临床专家、一个大规模的LLM评判者，以及一项有100名执业医师参与的临床医生用户研究。认知图可以从完整条件下的病例情境中恢复（MCC = +0.41，AUC = 0.70），但无法从零样本生成中恢复（MCC = +0.01，AUC = 0.50）。专家对完（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出FORMA框架，将障碍的认知模型编译为有向加权图来引导临床病例情境生成，实验证明其生成的病例情境能够保留指定的认知成分和因果联系，而零样本生成则无法做到。
en_tdlr: FORMA compiles a disorder's cognitive model into a directed weighted graph to generate clinical vignettes, and experiments show that the specified cognitive components and causal links are recoverable from FORMA-generated vignettes but not from zero-shot generation.
